no_adcom_quote.quote: There was no Advisory Committee Meeting required for this New Drug Application.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the original NDA021908 (Amitiza/lubiprostone) approval. The Medical Review's section 8.5 states there was no Advisory Committee Meeting required for this New Drug Application, and the Administrative Correspondence lists the Advisory Committee Meeting date as N/A and the section as not applicable. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
